figures.finding: Croatia's Incentive Programme, run by the Croatian Audiovisual Centre (HAVC) first come first served, rebates 25% of qualifying Croatian spending (goods, services, and wages of Croatian tax residents, VAT excluded), plus 5% in regions of below-average development, for features, documentaries, animation, TV films and series (not commercials, reality, game shows or soaps); the minimum Croatian spend is EUR 250,000 for a feature, EUR 150,000 for a TV film, EUR 100,000 an episode of a TV series and EUR 60,000 for a documentary or animation; the applicant must pass a cultural test, show 70% of the Croatian financing secured and hire at least 30% Croatian or EEA cast and crew (50% if shot wholly in Croatia).
figures.applies: Croatia, international and local productions, 2026 brochure.

sources.said: in the form of a rebate of 25% on qualifying Croatian spending. An additional 5% is approved for production in regions with below average development. … The Incentive Programme is administered on a first-come, first- served basis. The rebate is calculated on the total qualifying expenditure, excluding the value added tax … eur 250,000 for a feature film • eur 150,000 for a tv film • eur 100,000 for one episode of a tv series • eur 60,000 for a documentary film, animated film … (2) provide proof that at least 70% of the financing covering Croatian production costs has been secured, and (3) that at least 30% of the cast and crew are either Croatian or European Economic Area (eea) citizens, for production taking place partially in Croatia, or 50% for production taking place entirely in Croatia. … The Rebate does not apply to commercials, reality TV, game shows and soaps.

figures.finding: HAVC is Croatia's national film fund: it runs three feature schemes (Feature Films, First Feature Film, International Feature Co-productions), the first two open all year, plus documentary, short, animation and experimental schemes; the international co-production call has four deadlines a year.

sources.said: We currently operate three feature film support schemes: Feature Films Support Scheme, First Feature Film Support Scheme and International Feature Co-productions Scheme. The call for applications for Feature Films Support Scheme and First Feature Film Support scheme is open through the whole year. … is an open call with four yearly submission deadlines.
